name: stock_to_creation
description: Convert Freepik stock item → Pikaso creation. Use after user selects from stock_show.

folder_reference.description: Target project folder UUID. Omit to save without folder.

title.description: Creation display title. Defaults to "Stock item {id}".

type.description: Default: image. Use "video" for stock videos.

visible.description: Default: true. false keeps an image creation out of the library feed (a working asset, e.g. a generation reference). Ignored for video.
